grid.layout_notes: Described as 7x7 grid in official About text

win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 Land 5 or more connecting symbols of the same kind anywhere on the grid to get a winning combination.

 After every win the winning symbols are removed and new ones drop in. This continues until there are no more new wins on the reels.

respins.how_it_works:
This game features an overlaying MULTIPLIER symbol that will multiply your wins. If you land a MULTIPLIER on a winning cluster it will multiply your win with the current value. The maximum value of the multiplier is 128x.

These symbols will increase the size and value of the multiplier

 DOUBLE UP SYMBOLS

 The double up symbols will double the current multiplier value (up to maximum 128x). It is possible to land multiple double up symbols at the same time.

 GROW SYMBOLS

 Collect grow symbols to increase the size of the multiplier up to covering 4x4 symbols on the grid. Every time you reach 3 collected grow symbols the size of the multiplier will increase. The possible sizes for the multiplier symbol are: 2x2, 3x3 and 4x4 symbols. Every time the multiplier grows in size you will also be awarded with a respin!

modes.name: FREE SPINS
modes.trigger: Land 1UP symbols to get additional spins and extend the length of the feature.
modes.effects:
Get at least three free spin symbols to trigger the free spin feature. In this feature the multiplier value and size is kept progressively for the remainder of the free spins. The maximum value for the multiplier is 4x4 in size with a value of 128x!

When you start the feature you get 5 free spins. Land 1UP symbols to get additional spins and extend the length of the feature.

Double up symbols and grow symbols work the same way in the free spin mode as in the base game, except that the progress is saved between the rounds.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
ABOUT THE GAME

 Xpander is a 7x7 grid game featuring a max win of up to 10,000x. It is the latest release that features our Hoppers™ feature, within this series of games there is a hopping multiplier that is on the grid at all times, this innovative feature will really get that excitement flowing!

When the game starts you will see a multiplier overlaid on a random position on the reel. Between each spin, this multiplier will hop to a new position.
